card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or hyphen) just before a dose amount number, right after phrases like "the recommended dose is" or an age range label in a dosing table.

modes.label: Dose sentence
modes.description: Space right after "dose is" or "range of initial doses is", before the number.
modes.example: The range of initial doses is<< >>0.14 to 2 mg

modes.label: Age-based dosing table
modes.description: Space after an age band in a pediatric dosing table, before the dose amount.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next token away from number words like five and toward other continuations, with no clear dose-related effect.
card.plain: It fires on the blank spot just before a dose number is written in a dosing instruction or table.
